messages:
aisha_karim: Hi all — I was given temporary guardianship of a 7yo on 2026-03-15. Child was born abroad and only has an ITIN for now. Can I add them to medical + DC FSA? Our daycare is a small private provider overseas. What docs do you need and how will payroll proration work?
people-ops: Congrats and thanks for the heads-up. This is a Qualifying Life Event (placement/guardianship). You have 60 days from 3/15/2026 to submit the QLE form and docs. ITIN can be accepted temporarily; SSN to follow.
people-ops: Docs we need to accept enrollment: county placement letter or court order (showing placement date), placement agency letter, child ID (passport or birth cert) — if not English, certified translation. If SSN pending, upload ITIN and note SSN pending.
benefits_admin: Quick notes: 1) Health/dental/vision effective date = placement date once approved. 2) DC (dependent care) FSA has stricter receipts needs for foreign providers — we need proof of payment, provider name/address, and care dates. Please use this form for DC FSA exceptions: https://benefits.example.com/fsa-foreign-provider
payroll_ops: Proration: premiums are prorated back to placement date. Adjustments will hit payroll in the next payroll cycle; if amounts span pay periods we may split the adjustment. If you see anything unexpected ping payroll_ops.
aisha_karim: For the passport I can upload a certified translation but not an apostille yet. Is that fine to proceed?
people-ops: That's fine — certified translation + placement docs is sufficient to enroll. Mark in the upload that apostille is pending and we can update later.
benefits_admin: If SSN isn't provided within 60 days we may need to reverse retro coverage per IRS rules; we'll notify you before any change. For DC FSA with a foreign provider, include bank/transfer receipts showing amounts, provider contact, and a short affidavit describing care.
benefits-bot: Reminder: QLE window closes 60 days after 2249876543. Upload docs to the QLE portal: https://benefits.example.com/qle.
mike_mgr: @aisha_karim LMK if you need time off to sort documents or court visits — we can cover it. :thumbsup:
aisha_karim: Thanks everyone — submitting QLE now and will upload translation + placement letter. I'll follow up if payroll posts anything odd.
